verdicts.missing: The admin receives the result in the upload response. A background job for large files and a way to learn when that job finishes would need to be specified.

verdicts.quote: The HTTP request owns temporary bytes and parsed rows until response or disconnect. … The original file and bearer credential are absent from responses and user records.
The entire batch may be corrected and retried. … An interrupted upload before a complete body has no effect.
verdicts.missing: Cancellation after the body is complete is unspecified. Only the whole-batch retry is described, with no procedure for retrying just the failed rows.

verdicts.quote: The native HTTP service has no rendered interface, background processing, database, or hosted performance criterion.
verdicts.missing: The specification gives neither a completion-time bound for a maximum-size upload nor progress information for the admin.
